concepts.summary: Specialized subagents, including auditors/reviewers, implementers, and the advisory planning-router for ambiguous plan-family route decisions.

Slash command surfaces: planning-family route checks, contextual exits, plan_route_decision telemetry, review-family finding promotion, config.py export-env/should-notify wrappers, check-no-ask halt branches (7 commands), /z-overnight unattended pipeline orchestrator, /z-grill requirements-interview, /z-explain one-shot code explanation and /z-learn interactive tutor (four shared depth lenses), /z-git-guardrails PreToolUse hook installer, follow-up sink consumer commands (6 /z-followup-* commands), /z-where concurrent-run diagnostic, and persona-rotation (experiment.persona_rotation knob): random implementer draw + dual reviewer dispatch in z-implement-all/z-implement-next, fixed 5-panel consult in z-plan/z-debug, ideator/audit_persona/advisory-consult-arm draws.

Utility shell/Python scripts forming the operational backbone: structured event telemetry (log-event.sh/log-phase.sh), config/workflow resolver (config.py), git-safety PreToolUse hook (block-dangerous-git.sh), active-plan registry (active-plan-registry.py), persona-rotation analysis (persona-stats.py), follow-up sink subsystem (sink-*), and supporting test/preflight scripts.
Lightweight bug-fix command for the case where the user already has a diagnosis; single light-fix consult, inline implementation, non-negotiable Codex review, optional post-mortem.

Operational playbooks for z-harness slash commands: planning, debugging, implementation, review, docs-maintenance, memory authoring, stats, and quality uplift. Execution skills register with active-plan-registry; persona behavior (brainstorm/debug/plan/plan-light) augments neutral consults; kernel-path injection in z-debug/z-plan/z-implement-all; z-maintain-docs default=apply with --dry-run flag.

Config-file registry routing consultant/reviewer dispatches to any CLI-addressable LLM; three fixed roles mapped to named provider entries; resolution via scripts/resolve-provider.sh. Schema v2 uses -cli provider names with dual-entry + aliases for forward-compat. TOML [roles.*.*] bindings are preferred; providers.json.roles is legacy fallback.

Persona feature surface: layered persona registry (builtin < user-global < repo-local, last wins), three-axis binding (persona/model/runtime), contract enforcement per role, per-target export adapters, and persona-rotation experiment (random-for-role, forced-control, control-counter subcommands; boring-anchor as control; selection_source enum; persona_random_selected + persona_attempt_outcome + extended persona_bound telemetry).

Pipeline translating z-harness source files into Cursor (.mdc rules), Codex CLI (AGENTS.md + prompts), and Antigravity (workflows + rules + native skills + prompts); /z-export slash command; per-target CAPABILITIES.md documents dropped constructs; agy natively supports workspace skills via .agent/skills/<id>/SKILL.md.
Canonical plan layout under z-harness/plans/<slug>/; Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR override; dual-read fallback from legacy z-harness/<slug>/; migrate-plan-layout.sh for bulk or per-slug migration.
Explicit in-place plugin update via /z-update; detects symlink vs tarball mode; git pull --ff-only for symlink, atomic swap for tarball; no autoupdate; version tracked by scripts/version.sh.
Output envelope contract (STATUS line + fixed Markdown sections) that all external/domain lookup subagents must emit.
Haiku-tier subagent for external retrieval (web docs, public APIs, library docs) that offloads lookups from main context while enforcing a read-only verb-blocklist.

Post-run Haiku subagent that proposes 0-3 candidate memories from a completed /z-implement-all (Phase 9), /z-review-all (Phase 7), or /z-debug (Phase 10, shipped branch only) run. Reads run events, cumulative diff, SPEC.md or DEBUG.md; emits structured candidates as a fenced JSON block. Does not write — orchestrator owns all writes via /z-suggest-memory. Dispatched after skip-conditions check by scripts/run-memory-review.sh.
Tiered bulk codebase quality uplift: decompose into components, repo-wide cross-cutting pass, per-component audits, sequential implement via /z-implement-all.

Unified config concept covering Loader API (4-layer TOML loader: get, export-env, ensure-defaults, explain, should-notify) and Workflow Resolver (resolve-question, set, list-question-ids, [workflow] section, routing-preference memory schema, elevation proposer), and the [experiment] section (experiment.persona_rotation default true, experiment.control_every_n default 5) governing the persona-rotation feature.

Configuration cockpit: inspect resolved state, run guided concern-grouped wizard, or apply a posture preset (interactive/overnight/ci-batch). CLI is scripts/setup.py; /z-setup skill is the slash-command surface. Seven wizard scopes (all lowercase): notifications, workflow, overnight, providers, personas, docs, memories.

Durable follow-up registry draining out-of-scope discoveries into a priority-ordered lifecycle-tracked work queue. Three sinks (project, global, Notion mirror); conservative open->running->verify->done state machine; three completion paths (human-confirmed, audit-confirmed, auto-closed-low-risk). Shared module followup_common.py centralizes the two-tier lock model (per-entry + global cross-tool flock with .hb.lock-serialized holder JSON), batched config reads, and backgrounded Notion push. Event-sourced index.jsonl with incremental checkpoint rebuild (T010), compaction to index.archive.jsonl, corruption detection/repair, and materialized notion_sync_pending state.

Linear pipeline orchestrator that chains z-harness sub-commands unattended with halt-only interaction; Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt set only around Skill calls; 12 instrumented callsites (9 resolver + 3 new gates); flock-guarded overnight-state.json; MORNING_REPORT.md written on every terminal transition; resume via /z-overnight resume <RUN_ID>.

Durable external artifact base + lockless cross-session awareness registry with per-file lease/wait system. Five-tier base fallback (Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR > XDG_STATE_HOME > HOME/.local/state > git-common-dir > pwd/z-harness) with anchor enforcement prevents split-brain. Per-run schema-v2 JSON records (held_paths, waiting_on) enable advisory per-file leases: claim (lexicographic tiebreak, won-set-only persist), release (per-task success), wait-for (poll loop with budget, waiting_on cleared on every exit via finally), overlaps (scope + held_conflict). Five wait/lease env knobs: Z_HARNESS_AUTO_WAIT, Z_HARNESS_AUTO_WAIT_BUDGET_SECS, Z_HARNESS_WAIT_POLL_SECS, Z_HARNESS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS, Z_HARNESS_WAIT_REQUIRE_MERGE (deferred). Reaper live-local-pid carve-out: confirmed-alive local pids past 2x stale are marked stale but NOT deleted. Addresses the 2026-06-01 git clean incident.

LLM-free pre-run token-cost estimator (3 tiers: static/dispatch/empirical with parent-rollup + static-floor clamp), profile schema (token-cost-profiles.json), gate helper (pre-run-cost-gate.sh), workflow.pre_run_cost_gate enum gate + cost.token_budget integer knob; hard gates (z-research/z-uplift/z-plan-split) require user confirmation; soft gates (z-brainstorm HEAVY/z-audit HEAVY/z-debug) auto-proceed; overnight/no-ask budget rule; cost_gate_decision event.

Advisory behavioral rules mined from z-harness interaction history; lifecycle raw->candidate->approved with explicit user approval gate; five /z-axiom-* commands; KERNEL.md compiled by build-kernel.py and read by six behavioral subagents; axioms are the lowest-authority signal in the resolver — config/memory win direct conflicts but the conflict is surfaced via axiom_conflict envelope.

SESSION.md handoff artifact + context-curator Haiku subagent that eliminate O(N^2) cache_read growth in /z-implement-all. Notable-only breadcrumbs (E2) feed the curator; curator folds events delta + git diff + TASKS.md into a bounded SESSION.md at the compaction breakpoint (E3); done-set hash predicate re-seeds orchestrator context on resume (E1). Key env knobs: Z_SESSION_CURATOR_TIMEOUT_S (default 120, 0 disables) and Z_SESSION_MAX_CHARS (default 28000).

Unified Run Brief receipt (Intent/Approach/Decisions/Outcome/Next) emitted at finalize for 11 v1 registry commands; JSON canonical in archive/$RUN/run-brief.json; chat and push rendered via render-run-brief.py.

Per-host fidelity tiers and command-capability grid for the z-harness CLI adapters. native (claude) = full orchestration + native personas; high (antigravity) = native skills/personas, single-agent, multi-agent commands degraded; flattened (cursor, codex) = transliterated rules, single-agent, multi-agent commands blocked.
